description: This file defines the ChatConnection class and its inner classes, managing both server and client socket connections for a chat application on Android. It handles establishing server sockets, connecting to remote hosts, sending and receiving messages, and updating UI components via a Handler.

classes.name: ChatConnection
classes.description: Manages TCP socket communication for chat, including server and client socket handling, message sending/receiving, and connection management.

methods.name: ChatConnection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection with a handler.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Initiates a client connection to specified server address and port.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message via the client connection.

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.description: Returns the local port number used by the server socket.

methods.name: updateMessages
methods.description: Updates UI with a new message, indicating if it was sent locally or received.

methods.name: setSocket
methods.description: Assigns a socket, closing existing one if necessary.
